I replied to Dana in the #north-team thread: the Zoom Room B hub replacement is **IT ticket #4092**.

Ilse posted it in #north-random yesterday (13 Oct, 11:55). In the same message she warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom. I included that in the reply too.

Dana is a member of #north-random, so this is something she could already see herself. I checked her membership before reading the channel.
